chars.NARRATOR: a young Moroccan man in his early 20s with short black curly hair and light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with white stripes on the sleeves, dark blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.BUYER: a middle-aged Moroccan man with a grey mustache, wearing a brown leather jacket over a red-and-blue checkered shirt and a grey flat cap
chars.HABOUS: a thin young Moroccan man with a shaved head, wearing a bright red tracksuit with black stripes and a black cap worn backwards

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR crouches at a busy weekly flea market in Casablanca, digging eagerly through a blanket piled with old broken phones and toys, holding up a cracked phone with a curious grin; sellers and stalls softly blurred behind. Vertical 2D cartoon illustration, no text, no letters, no signs.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits at a cluttered small repair counter in a Moroccan neighbourhood shop, opening the back of a broken phone with a tiny screwdriver, focused, tools and phone parts around him. Vertical 2D cartoon illustration, no text, no letters, no signs.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR at night in his small bedroom in Casablanca, leaning toward a laptop screen glowing in the dark, watching a repair tutorial while holding an opened phone, eyes wide with concentration. Vertical 2D cartoon illustration, no text, no letters, no signs.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR at the flea market hands a single banknote to an old street seller and receives a cracked phone, winking at the camera, dusty market stalls behind. Vertical 2D cartoon illustration, no text, no letters, no signs.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR proudly lines up several repaired shiny phones on a wooden table at home, arms crossed, big satisfied smile. Vertical 2D cartoon illustration, no text, no letters, no signs.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR takes a photo of a repaired phone placed on a clean white cloth with his own smartphone, posing it carefully like a pro seller, in a simple Moroccan living room. Vertical 2D cartoon illustration, no text, no letters, no signs.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: on a sunny Casablanca street corner, BUYER haggles with NARRATOR, raising his fingers to show a price and frowning theatrically while NARRATOR shakes his head with a cheeky smile, holding the phone. Vertical 2D cartoon illustration, no text, no letters, no signs.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits on his bed counting a small stack of Moroccan dirham banknotes, laughing happily, a few phones beside him. Vertical 2D cartoon illustration, no text, no letters, no signs.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: in the evening under old arches of the Habous quarter of Casablanca, HABOUS leans close to NARRATOR holding out a sleek smartphone with a sly suspicious smile, NARRATOR looks at it unsure and wary. Vertical 2D cartoon illustration, no text, no letters, no signs.
